Equilibrium: y = 2.4x/(1 + 1.4x); inverse: x = y/(2.4 - 1.4y).
(a) D = F(z_F - x_B)/(x_D - x_B) = 100(0.41)/(0.92) = 44.57 kmol/h. B = 55.43 kmol/h.
(b) q-line: y = [q/(q-1)]x - z_F/(q-1) = -1.5x + 1.125.
Pinch: 2.4x/(1 + 1.4x) = -1.5x + 1.125 gives 2.1x^2 + 2.325x - 1.125 = 0, so x_p = 0.3641, y_p = 0.5788.
R_min = (x_D - y_p)/(y_p - x_p) = 0.3812/0.2147 = 1.775.
(c) R = 1.5 R_min = 1.5(1.775) = 2.66.
Rectifying line: y = [R/(R+1)]x + x_D/(R+1) = 0.727x + 0.262.
Flows: L = RD = 118.68, V = L + D = 163.25, L' = L + qF = 178.68, V' = V - (1 - q)F = 123.25 kmol/h.
Stripping line: y = (L'/V')x - Bx_B/V' = 1.450x - 0.018.
Intersection: 0.727x + 0.262 = 1.450x - 0.018 gives x_int = 0.387.
(d) Stepping with x = y/(2.4 - 1.4y) from y_1 = x_D = 0.96, on the rectifying line:
Stage 1: x = 0.909; Stage 2: x = 0.833; Stage 3: x = 0.732; Stage 4: x = 0.617; Stage 5: x = 0.506; Stage 6: x = 0.415.
Stage 7: x = 0.350, the first below x_int = 0.387; switch to the stripping line.
Stage 8: x = 0.285; Stage 9: x = 0.214; Stage 10: x = 0.147; Stage 11: x = 0.0917; Stage 12: x = 0.0513; Stage 13: x = 0.0243.
Stage 13 gives x below x_B = 0.04, so stage 13 is the last stage (the partial reboiler).
Fraction of last stage = (x_12 - x_B)/(x_12 - x_13) = (0.0513 - 0.04)/(0.0513 - 0.0243) = 0.0113/0.0270 = 0.42.
Total stages = 12 + 0.42 = 12.42.
(e) The feed stage is stage 7, whose liquid composition first falls below x_int.
